source: Read-only installed extension compiler marker; pinned official compiler source; exhaustive Unicode scalar verification; synthetic installed-wheel wrapper references
reference_instrumentation: The original compiler Unicode source is unchanged except two crate::intrinsics::assume calls are replaced by ordinary assertions, checked for every scalar.
Public std::ops and std::cmp are re-exported at the verification crate root.
The exact char method ASCII fast paths from the pinned methods.rs are applied around the original lookup functions.
Each emitted property flag and full char case mapping is compared with the actual Go table ranges/mappings, without using Python Unicode properties.

observable_dependencies.Alphabetic: Anime title and release group unknown-span eligibility; bracket and preceding-token checks.
observable_dependencies.Numeric: contains_digit episode candidate scan and alphanumeric title eligibility; source ASCII numeric conversion remains separate.
observable_dependencies.UppercaseMapping: Keyword lookup normalization and first-letter name casing.

limits: The exhaustive comparison covers the listed scalar predicates and mappings, not all stdlib, regex engine semantics or arbitrary complete MetaInfo inputs.
Installed wheel wrapper cases exercise observable parser effects but are a finite synthetic sample.
Legacy Anitopy 2.1.1 remains an independent unfinished port.
